editorial:
Imagine finding out the sun is about to blow up and take the whole world with it. That is the scary spot where you find the characters in this story. You follow a tight group of teenagers who realize they do not have much time left. Instead of hiding in a basement or panicking, they decide to spend their final days doing all the things they always wanted to do. The vibe is a mix of sad and sweet, making you feel like you are part of their friend group as they chase thrills and say their goodbyes.

You will really love how the actors make the friendship feel real, though some parts of the middle feel a bit slow. The best part is seeing how each teen handles the end of the world differently. If you want a movie that makes you hug your friends, you should definitely check this out. It looks beautiful, so you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move to keep the quality high.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, the friends gather on a beach to watch the sun grow larger in the sky. They stop running and simply hold hands, accepting that the end is here. There is no secret miracle or last-minute rescue. As the screen turns a bright, blinding white, you realize the movie is about finding peace with your loved ones. They die together in a flash of light, showing that love is the only thing that matters.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves coming-of-age stories with a sad twist.
